value.rationale: The boundary rates and per-site capacity are native physical parameters of the recently proposed multi-floor exclusion model. Even its smallest two-site chain poses a meaningful qualitative question: does back-pressure produce exclusion-like anticorrelation at maximal injection/removal rates? The exact c=1,2,3 classification proves the natural *first* capacity where the sign reverses, exhibits a unique nontrivial capacity-two rate frontier, and shows c=3 retains positive covariance throughout the physical rate domain. This answers a defined parameter-boundary question not accessible from the cited bulk-current results. It is not mere algebraic substitution or a numerical sample; the finite-size and higher-capacity limits are stated.
